jobs.description:
## Description
The Finance Transformation is building a leading connected, collaborative Finance Function which is faster and more insight-driven. We will do this by transforming everything we do, every process, data and tool and injecting new ways of work and AI to amplify our Finance talent.

To support this ambition, Group Finance is launching the implementation of SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, which is a key project within Finance Transformation.
We are looking for a Lead – Reporting Solution SAP Group Reporting. The role will be responsible for designing and deploying reporting solutions for SAP Group Reporting based on SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud and Data Bricks. Key Responsibilities are:

- Lead the reporting work stream within the wider SAP Group Reporting program, including design, build, testing and deployment to business users.
- Define the target reporting architecture for Group reporting.
- Design analytical views and reports that consume SAP Group Reporting data.
- Coordinate data integration between SAP Group Reporting, SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks.
- Ensure that reporting solutions are accurate, controlled and aligned with Group Finance requirements (IFRS, management reporting, KPIs).

## What you will do

- Define the target reporting architecture for SAP Group Reporting, leveraging SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks.
- Design data views, virtual data models and semantic layers that provide a single source of truth for Group reporting.
- Translate business requirements into concrete reports, dashboards and analytical models
- Drive the build of:
- SAP Fiori / Embedded Analytics reports,
- Self‑service analytics via SAP Business Data Cloud
- Analytical models and data products in Databricks where needed.
- Coordinate data flows between SAP Group Reporting, Business Data Cloud and Databricks in close collaboration with IT and data teams.
- Run workshops with Group Finance, BU Finance and other stakeholders to capture and prioritise reporting needs
- Lead the Reporting Solution work stream within the wider SAP Group Reporting programme.
- Own the work stream plan, milestones, dependencies and risks; provide regular status updates to programme management.
- Coordinate design, build, SIT/UAT, and deployment activities for reporting solutions.
- Prepare cut‑over and handover to BAU, including documentation, training and support model.
- Define test strategy, test cases and acceptance criteria for reporting solutions.
- Coordinate test execution with Finance and IT, manage defects and ensure resolution before go‑live.

## What you bring

- Practical experience with:
- SAP Embedded Analytics (e.g. CDS views, Fiori reporting),
- Cloud based data and analytics platforms (SAP Business Data Cloud, Databricks or similar).
- Hands on experience with SAP Group Reporting or comparable SAP consolidation / reporting tools (e.g. S/4HANA Finance, BPC, BW/4HANA).
- Strong experience in Group Reporting / consolidation and financial close processes (month end, quarter end, year end).
- Bachelor or Master in Finance or Finance/IT
- Proven track record leading a work stream or project in a finance / IT transformation programme.
- Experience in planning, tracking and delivering milestones, managing risks and dependencies.
- Experience in planning, tracking and delivering milestones, managing risks and dependencies.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with Group Finance, BU Finance, IT, data teams and external partners.
- Experience with SIT/UAT, test case definition and defect management.
- Exposure to change management and handover to BAU (training, manuals, support processes).
- Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
- Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.

## You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

## About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

## Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

## Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?
We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new way

Per sostenere questa ambizione, Group Finance sta avviando l'implementazione di SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, un progetto chiave all'interno della Finance Transformation. Cerchiamo un Lead – Reporting Solution SAP Group Reporting. Il ruolo sarà responsabile della progettazione e dell'implementazione di soluzioni di reporting per SAP Group Reporting basate su SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud e Databricks. Le responsabilità principali sono:

- Guidare il work stream di reporting all'interno del programma SAP Group Reporting, inclusi progettazione, sviluppo, test e distribuzione agli utenti aziendali.
- Definire l'architettura di reporting target per il Group Reporting.
- Progettare viste analitiche e report che utilizzano i dati di SAP Group Reporting.
- Coordinare l'integrazione dei dati tra SAP Group Reporting, SAP Business Data Cloud e Databricks.
- Garantire che le soluzioni di reporting siano accurate, controllate e allineate ai requisiti di Group Finance (IFRS, reporting gestionale, KPI).

Cosa farai

- Definire l'architettura di reporting target per SAP Group Reporting, sfruttando SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud e Databricks.
- Progettare viste dati, modelli di dati virtuali e livelli semantici che forniscano un'unica fonte di verità per il Group Reporting.
- Tradurre i requisiti aziendali in report, dashboard e modelli analitici concreti.
- Guidare la creazione di: report SAP Fiori / Embedded Analytics, analytics self-service tramite SAP Business Data Cloud, modelli analitici e data product in Databricks dove necessario.
- Coordinare i flussi di dati tra SAP Group Reporting, Business Data Cloud e Databricks in stretta collaborazione con i team IT e dati.
- Condurre workshop con Group Finance, BU Finance e altri stakeholder per acquisire e dare priorità alle esigenze di reporting.
- Guidare il work stream Reporting Solution all'interno del più ampio programma SAP Group Reporting.
- Gestire il piano del work stream, le milestone, le dipendenze e i rischi; fornire aggiornamenti regolari sullo stato alla direzione del programma.
- Coordinare le attività di progettazione, sviluppo, SIT/UAT e distribuzione per le soluzioni di reporting.
- Preparare il cut-over e il passaggio alla BAU (Business As Usual), inclusi documentazione, formazione e modello di supporto.
- Definire la strategia di test, i casi di test e i criteri di accettazione per le soluzioni di reporting.
- Coordinare l'esecuzione dei test con Finance e IT, gestire i difetti e garantire la risoluzione prima del go-live.

Cosa porti

- Esperienza pratica con: SAP Embedded Analytics (es. viste CDS, reporting Fiori), piattaforme dati e analytics basate su cloud (SAP Business Data Cloud, Databricks o simili).
- Esperienza pratica con SAP Group Reporting o strumenti di consolidamento/reporting SAP comparabili (es. S/4HANA Finance, BPC, BW/4HANA).
- Solida esperienza in Group Reporting / consolidamento e processi di chiusura finanziaria (fine mese, fine trimestre, fine anno).
- Laurea triennale o magistrale in Finanza o Finanza/IT.
- Comprovata esperienza nella guida di un work stream o progetto in un programma di trasformazione Finance/IT.
- Esperienza nella pianificazione, monitoraggio e consegna di milestone, gestione di rischi e dipendenze.
- Forti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, in grado di lavorare efficacemente con Group Finance, BU Finance, IT, team dati e partner esterni.
- Esperienza con SIT/UAT, definizione dei casi di test e gestione dei difetti.
- Esposizione al change management e al passaggio alla BAU (formazione, manuali, processi di supporto).
- Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive sono un plus.
- Esperienza di lavoro in programmi complessi e globali, preferibilmente nel settore assicurativo o dei servizi finanziari.
- Forti capacità di collaborazione e attitudine al lavoro di squadra, supportando sia i colleghi Finance che quelli IT.

Il tuo posto è qui.

Immagina di lavorare in uno degli ambienti di lavoro più sostenibili al mondo. Al Quai Zurich Campus, godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a crescere, con benefit che supportano il tuo benessere e il tuo impatto, e opportunità per dare il meglio di te, circondato da talenti di alto livello e colleghi solidali.
Avrai accesso a opzioni alimentari sane, strutture per il fitness e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che stimolano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre eccellenti collegamenti con i trasporti pubblici, rendendo il tuo tragitto semplice.
Cresci con noi attraverso l'accesso a risorse di apprendimento, sviluppo sul lavoro e supporto continuo. Fai parte di un team che sta creando insieme un futuro più luminoso.

Chi siamo

Zurich è un assicuratore multi-linea leader, che serve oltre 82 milioni di clienti in più di 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.
Da oltre 150 anni, Zurich trasforma il settore assicurativo, offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.
Guidati dal nostro scopo di 'creare insieme un futuro più luminoso', miriamo a essere una delle aziende più responsabili e di impatto al mondo.
Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online oggi stesso!

To support this ambition, Group Finance is launching the implementation of SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, which is a key project within Finance Transformation.
We are looking for a Lead – Reporting Solution SAP Group Reporting. The role will be responsible for designing and deploying reporting solutions for SAP Group Reporting based on SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud and Data Bricks. Key Responsibilities are:

- Lead the reporting work stream within the wider SAP Group Reporting program, including design, build, testing and deployment to business users.
- Define the target reporting architecture for Group reporting.
- Design analytical views and reports that consume SAP Group Reporting data.
- Coordinate data integration between SAP Group Reporting, SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks.
- Ensure that reporting solutions are accurate, controlled and aligned with Group Finance requirements (IFRS, management reporting, KPIs).

What you will do

- Define the target reporting architecture for SAP Group Reporting, leveraging SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks.
- Design data views, virtual data models and semantic layers that provide a single source of truth for Group reporting.
- Translate business requirements into concrete reports, dashboards and analytical models
- Drive the build of:
- SAP Fiori / Embedded Analytics reports,
- Self‑service analytics via SAP Business Data Cloud
- Analytical models and data products in Databricks where needed.
- Coordinate data flows between SAP Group Reporting, Business Data Cloud and Databricks in close collaboration with IT and data teams.
- Run workshops with Group Finance, BU Finance and other stakeholders to capture and prioritise reporting needs
- Lead the Reporting Solution work stream within the wider SAP Group Reporting programme.
- Own the work stream plan, milestones, dependencies and risks; provide regular status updates to programme management.
- Coordinate design, build, SIT/UAT, and deployment activities for reporting solutions.
- Prepare cut‑over and handover to BAU, including documentation, training and support model.
- Define test strategy, test cases and acceptance criteria for reporting solutions.
- Coordinate test execution with Finance and IT, manage defects and ensure resolution before go‑live.

What you bring

- Practical experience with:
- SAP Embedded Analytics (e.g. CDS views, Fiori reporting),
- Cloud based data and analytics platforms (SAP Business Data Cloud, Databricks or similar).
- Hands on experience with SAP Group Reporting or comparable SAP consolidation / reporting tools (e.g. S/4HANA Finance, BPC, BW/4HANA).
- Strong experience in Group Reporting / consolidation and financial close processes (month end, quarter end, year end).
- Bachelor or Master in Finance or Finance/IT
- Proven track record leading a work stream or project in a finance / IT transformation programme.
- Experience in planning, tracking and delivering milestones, managing risks and dependencies.
- Experience in planning, tracking and delivering milestones, managing risks and dependencies.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with Group Finance, BU Finance, IT, data teams and external partners.
- Experience with SIT/UAT, test case definition and defect management.
- Exposure to change management and handover to BAU (training, manuals, support processes).
- Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
- Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.
Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Die Finance Transformation baut eine führende, vernetzte und kollaborative Finanzfunktion auf, die schneller und erkenntnisorientierter arbeitet. Um dieses Ziel zu unterstützen, startet Group Finance die Implementierung von SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, ein Schlüsselprojekt innerhalb der Finance Transformation. - Leitung des Reporting-Workstreams innerhalb des SAP Group Reporting-Programms, einschließlich Design, Aufbau, Test und Bereitstellung für Business-Anwender.

- Koordination der Datenintegration zwischen SAP Group Reporting, SAP Business Data Cloud und Databricks.
- Sicherstellung, dass Reporting-Lösungen präzise, kontrolliert und auf die Anforderungen von Group Finance (IFRS, Management Reporting, KPIs) abgestimmt sind.

Was Sie tun werden

- Definition der Ziel-Reporting-Architektur für SAP Group Reporting unter Nutzung von SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud und Databricks.
- Design von Daten-Views, virtuellen Datenmodellen und semantischen Schichten, die eine Single Source of Truth für das Group Reporting bieten.
- Übersetzung von Geschäftsanforderungen in konkrete Berichte, Dashboards und analytische Modelle.
- Leitung des Aufbaus von: SAP Fiori / Embedded Analytics Berichten, Self-Service Analytics via SAP Business Data Cloud, analytischen Modellen und Datenprodukten in Databricks bei Bedarf.
- Koordination der Datenflüsse zwischen SAP Group Reporting, Business Data Cloud und Databricks in enger Zusammenarbeit mit IT- und Datenteams.

- Leitung des Reporting Solution-Workstreams innerhalb des SAP Group Reporting-Programms.
- Verantwortung für den Workstream-Plan, Meilensteine, Abhängigkeiten und Risiken; regelmäßige Status-Updates an das Programm-Management.
- Koordination von Design, Aufbau, SIT/UAT und Deployment-Aktivitäten für Reporting-Lösungen.
- Vorbereitung des Cut-overs und der Übergabe an den BAU-Betrieb, einschließlich Dokumentation, Training und Support-Modell.
- Definition der Teststrategie, Testfälle und Abnahmekriterien für Reporting-Lösungen.
- Koordination der Testdurchführung mit Finance und IT, Management von Fehlern und Sicherstellung der Behebung vor dem Go-live.

Was Sie mitbringen

- Praktische Erfahrung mit: SAP Embedded Analytics (z.B. CDS Views, Fiori Reporting), Cloud-basierten Daten- und Analyseplattformen (SAP Business Data Cloud, Databricks oder ähnlich).
- Hands-on-Erfahrung mit SAP Group Reporting oder vergleichbaren SAP-Konsolidierungs-/Reporting-Tools (z.B. S/4HANA Finance, BPC, BW/4HANA).
- Fundierte Erfahrung im Group Reporting / Konsolidierung und Finanzabschlussprozessen (Monats-, Quartals-, Jahresabschluss).
- Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Finanzen oder Finanzen/IT.
- Nachweisliche Erfolge bei der Leitung eines Workstreams oder Projekts in einem Finanz-/IT-Transformationsprogramm.
- Erfahrung in der Planung, Nachverfolgung und Lieferung von Meilensteinen sowie im Management von Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.
- Starke Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, effektive Zusammenarbeit mit Group Finance, BU Finance, IT, Datenteams und externen Partnern.
- Erfahrung mit SIT/UAT, Testfalldefinition und Fehlermanagement.
- Erfahrung mit Change Management und Übergabe an den BAU-Betrieb (Training, Handbücher, Support-Prozesse).
- Fließend in Englisch; weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in komplexen, globalen Programmen, vorzugsweise im Versicherungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungssektor.
- Starke Kollaborationsfähigkeiten und eine „One Team“-Einstellung, die sowohl Finance- als auch IT-Kollegen unterstützt.

Sie gehören hierher.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zurich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die darauf ausgelegt ist, dass Sie Ihr Bestes geben können, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.
Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Verpflegungsoptionen, Fitnessmöglichkeiten und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität fördern. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus exzellente Anbindungen an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr, was Ihren Arbeitsweg einfach macht.
Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Unterstützung. Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine hellere Zukunft gestaltet.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multi-Line-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Gebieten mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern betreut.
Seit über 150 Jahren transformiert Zurich die Versicherungswelt – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsdienste, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresilienz fördern.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung noch heute!

Zurich akzeptiert für diese Position keine Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlungsagenturen. Wir lehnen jegliche Verantwortung für unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen sowie damit verbundene Gebühren ab.

Warum Zurich

Bei Zurich denken wir gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hinterfragen den Status quo. Wir verfolgen einen optimistischen Ansatz, indem wir uns auf das Positive konzentrieren und uns ständig fragen: Was kann gut laufen?
Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und weiß, dass jeder Mitarbeiter einzigartig ist – das macht unser Team so großartig!
Begleiten Sie uns, während wir ständig neue Wege erkunden.

Nous recherchons un Lead – Reporting Solution SAP Group Reporting. Le rôle sera responsable de la conception et du déploiement de solutions de reporting pour SAP Group Reporting basées sur SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Business Data Cloud et Databricks. - Expérience avérée dans la direction d'un flux de travail ou d'un projet dans un programme de transformation Finance/IT.

## Description
The Finance Transformation is building a leading connected, collaborative Finance Function which is faster and more insight-driven. We will do this by transforming everything we do, every process, data and tool and injecting new ways of work and AI to amplify our Finance talent.

To support this ambition, Group Finance is launching the implementation of SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, which is a key project within Finance Transformation.
We are looking for a Lead - Inbound Data Flow SAP Group Reporting. The role will be responsible for designing, implementing and governing the end to end data flows from source systems into SAP Group Reporting, ensuring accurate, timely and controlled financial data for Group and BU reporting.

This role will shape how financial data moves from local ledgers and sub systems through integration layers into the consolidation engine, enabling a reliable close process and high quality Group reporting.

## What you will do
- Define target data flow architecture from source ledgers and sub-systems into SAP Group Reporting (including mapping, transformation and validation steps).
- Ensure solutions support IFRS, local GAAP and management reporting requirements.
- Coordinate extraction, transformation and loading (ETL/ELT) processes from source systems to consolidation.
- Drive data quality improvements with Finance, Group Accounting, and IT (e.g. resolving data gaps, inconsistencies, timing issues).
- Design and document standardized inbound data processes.
- Facilitate workshops to clarify requirements, align timelines, and resolve cross-functional issues.
- Communicate impacts of system or process changes on Group Reporting and local finance teams.
- Lead the inbound data work stream within broader SAP Group Reporting / consolidation programs.
- Plan and track work stream deliverables, milestones, risks and dependencies.
- Coordinate functional and technical testing (SIT, UAT) for interfaces and data flows; manage defect resolution.
- Support change management, training and handover to BAU teams.

## What you bring
- Experience in SAP ECCS, SEM-BCS and/or SAP Group Reporting, at least 5 years experience.
- Experience in SAP Public Cloud.
- Experience in designing SAP GRDC.
- Knowledgeable in Group Accounting processes with focus on Financial Consolidation.
- Bachelor or Master in Finance or Finance/IT.
- Understanding of SAP data structures (charts of accounts, ledgers, FS items, dimensions).
- Practical experience with interfaces/ETL, data mappings and reconciliations between source systems and consolidation tools.
- Experience in planning, tracking and delivering milestones, managing risks and dependencies.
- Ability to work effectively with Group Finance, BU Finance, IT, and external partners.
- Strong communication skills, able to translate between finance and technical teams.
- Experience with SIT/UAT, test case definition and defect management.
- Structured, analytical way of working with strong problem solving skills.
- High attention to detail and quality, especially regarding financial data.
- Resilient and comfortable working under time pressure during closing cycles.
- Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.
- Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.

## You belong here.
Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.
We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

## Why Zurich
At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?
We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

- Remote working: No
- Schedule: Full Time
- Recruiter name: Mélina Carnal

Descrizione
La Finance Transformation sta costruendo una funzione Finance leader, connessa e collaborativa, più veloce e orientata agli insight. Lo faremo trasformando tutto ciò che facciamo, ogni processo, dato e strumento, e introducendo nuove modalità di lavoro e l'IA per potenziare il nostro talento finanziario.

Per sostenere questa ambizione, Group Finance sta lanciando l'implementazione di SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, un progetto chiave all'interno della Finance Transformation. Cerchiamo un Lead - Inbound Data Flow SAP Group Reporting. Il ruolo sarà responsabile della progettazione, implementazione e governance dei flussi di dati end-to-end dai sistemi sorgente a SAP Group Reporting, garantendo dati finanziari accurati, tempestivi e controllati per il reporting di Gruppo e delle Business Unit.

Questo ruolo definirà il modo in cui i dati finanziari si spostano dai registri locali e dai sottosistemi attraverso i livelli di integrazione fino al motore di consolidamento, consentendo un processo di chiusura affidabile e un reporting di Gruppo di alta qualità.

Cosa farai
- Definire l'architettura del flusso di dati target dai registri sorgente e dai sottosistemi a SAP Group Reporting (inclusi passaggi di mappatura, trasformazione e validazione).
- Garantire che le soluzioni supportino i requisiti IFRS, GAAP locali e di gestione.
- Coordinare i processi di estrazione, trasformazione e caricamento (ETL/ELT) dai sistemi sorgente al consolidamento.
- Guidare i miglioramenti della qualità dei dati con Finance, Group Accounting e IT (es. risoluzione di lacune nei dati, incoerenze, problemi di tempistica).
- Progettare e documentare processi standardizzati di inbound data.
- Facilitare workshop per chiarire i requisiti, allineare le tempistiche e risolvere problemi interfunzionali.
- Comunicare gli impatti dei cambiamenti di sistema o di processo al Group Reporting e ai team finanziari locali.
- Guidare il work stream dei dati in entrata all'interno dei più ampi programmi SAP Group Reporting / consolidamento.
- Pianificare e monitorare i risultati, le pietre miliari, i rischi e le dipendenze del work stream.
- Coordinare i test funzionali e tecnici (SIT, UAT) per interfacce e flussi di dati; gestire la risoluzione dei difetti.
- Supportare il change management, la formazione e il passaggio ai team BAU.

Cosa porti
- Esperienza in SAP ECCS, SEM-BCS e/o SAP Group Reporting, almeno 5 anni di esperienza.
- Esperienza in SAP Public Cloud.
- Esperienza nella progettazione di SAP GRDC.
- Conoscenza dei processi di Group Accounting con focus sul consolidamento finanziario.
- Laurea triennale o magistrale in Finanza o Finanza/IT.
- Comprensione delle strutture dati SAP (piani dei conti, registri, voci FS, dimensioni).
- Esperienza pratica con interfacce/ETL, mappature dati e riconciliazioni tra sistemi sorgente e strumenti di consolidamento.
- Esperienza nella pianificazione, monitoraggio e consegna di pietre miliari, gestione di rischi e dipendenze.
- Capacità di lavorare efficacemente con Group Finance, BU Finance, IT e partner esterni.
- Forti capacità comunicative, in grado di tradurre tra team finanziari e tecnici.
- Esperienza con SIT/UAT, definizione di casi di test e gestione dei difetti.
- Metodo di lavoro strutturato e analitico con forti capacità di problem solving.
- Grande attenzione ai dettagli e alla qualità, specialmente riguardo ai dati finanziari.
- Resilienza e comfort nel lavorare sotto pressione durante i cicli di chiusura.

Description
The Finance Transformation is building a leading connected, collaborative Finance Function which is faster and more insight-driven. We will do this by transforming everything we do, every process, data and tool and injecting new ways of work and AI to amplify our Finance talent.

To support this ambition, Group Finance is launching the implementation of SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, which is a key project within Finance Transformation.
We are looking for a Lead - Inbound Data Flow SAP Group Reporting. The role will be responsible for designing, implementing and governing the end to end data flows from source systems into SAP Group Reporting, ensuring accurate, timely and controlled financial data for Group and BU reporting.

This role will shape how financial data moves from local ledgers and sub systems through integration layers into the consolidation engine, enabling a reliable close process and high quality Group reporting.

What you will do
- Define target data flow architecture from source ledgers and sub-systems into SAP Group Reporting (including mapping, transformation and validation steps).
- Ensure solutions support IFRS, local GAAP and management reporting requirements.
- Coordinate extraction, transformation and loading (ETL/ELT) processes from source systems to consolidation.
- Drive data quality improvements with Finance, Group Accounting, and IT (e.g. resolving data gaps, inconsistencies, timing issues).
- Design and document standardized inbound data processes.
- Facilitate workshops to clarify requirements, align timelines, and resolve cross-functional issues.
- Communicate impacts of system or process changes on Group Reporting and local finance teams.
- Lead the inbound data work stream within broader SAP Group Reporting / consolidation programs.
- Plan and track work stream deliverables, milestones, risks and dependencies.
- Coordinate functional and technical testing (SIT, UAT) for interfaces and data flows; manage defect resolution.
- Support change management, training and handover to BAU teams.

What you bring
- Experience in SAP ECCS, SEM-BCS and/or SAP Group Reporting, at least 5 years experience.
- Experience in SAP Public Cloud.
- Experience in designing SAP GRDC.
- Knowledgeable in Group Accounting processes with focus on Financial Consolidation.
- Bachelor or Master in Finance or Finance/IT.
- Understanding of SAP data structures (charts of accounts, ledgers, FS items, dimensions).
- Practical experience with interfaces/ETL, data mappings and reconciliations between source systems and consolidation tools.
- Experience in planning, tracking and delivering milestones, managing risks and dependencies.
- Ability to work effectively with Group Finance, BU Finance, IT, and external partners.
- Strong communication skills, able to translate between finance and technical teams.
- Experience with SIT/UAT, test case definition and defect management.
- Structured, analytical way of working with strong problem solving skills.
- High attention to detail and quality, especially regarding financial data.
- Resilient and comfortable working under time pressure during closing cycles.
- Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.
- Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.

You belong here.
Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

- Erfahrung im Design von SAP GRDC.
- Kenntnisse in Group Accounting-Prozessen mit Fokus auf Finanzkonsolidierung.

- Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägten Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.
- Hohe Detailgenauigkeit und Qualitätsbewusstsein, insbesondere bei Finanzdaten.
- Belastbarkeit und Komfort bei der Arbeit unter Zeitdruck während Abschlusszyklen.

- Erfahrung in komplexen, globalen Programmen, vorzugsweise im Versicherungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungssektor.

Sie gehören hierher.

Description
La transformation financière construit une fonction Finance de premier plan, connectée et collaborative, plus rapide et axée sur les données. Nous y parviendrons en transformant tout ce que nous faisons, chaque processus, donnée et outil, et en injectant de nouvelles méthodes de travail et l'IA pour amplifier nos talents financiers.

Pour soutenir cette ambition, Group Finance lance la mise en œuvre de SAP Group Reporting Public Cloud, un projet clé au sein de la transformation financière. Nous recherchons un Lead - Inbound Data Flow SAP Group Reporting. Le rôle sera responsable de la conception, de la mise en œuvre et de la gouvernance des flux de données de bout en bout depuis les systèmes sources vers SAP Group Reporting, garantissant des données financières précises, opportunes et contrôlées pour le reporting du Groupe et des BU.

Ce rôle façonnera la manière dont les données financières circulent depuis les grands livres locaux et les sous-systèmes via des couches d'intégration jusqu'au moteur de consolidation, permettant un processus de clôture fiable et un reporting de groupe de haute qualité.

Ce que vous ferez
- Définir l'architecture cible des flux de données depuis les grands livres sources et les sous-systèmes vers SAP Group Reporting (y compris les étapes de mappage, de transformation et de validation).
- S'assurer que les solutions prennent en charge les exigences IFRS, GAAP locales et de reporting de gestion.
- Coordonner les processus d'extraction, de transformation et de chargement (ETL/ELT) depuis les systèmes sources vers la consolidation.
- Piloter les améliorations de la qualité des données avec Finance, Group Accounting et IT (ex: résolution des lacunes de données, incohérences, problèmes de timing).
- Concevoir et documenter des processus de données entrants standardisés.
- Animer des ateliers pour clarifier les exigences, aligner les délais et résoudre les problèmes interfonctionnels.
- Communiquer les impacts des changements de système ou de processus sur le Group Reporting et les équipes financières locales.
- Diriger le flux de travail des données entrantes au sein des programmes plus larges de SAP Group Reporting / consolidation.
- Planifier et suivre les livrables, les jalons, les risques et les dépendances du flux de travail.
- Coordonner les tests fonctionnels et techniques (SIT, UAT) pour les interfaces et les flux de données ; gérer la résolution des défauts.
- Soutenir la gestion du changement, la formation et le transfert aux équipes BAU.

Ce que vous apportez
- Expérience dans SAP ECCS, SEM-BCS et/ou SAP Group Reporting, au moins 5 ans d'expérience.
- Expérience dans SAP Public Cloud.
- Expérience dans la conception de SAP GRDC.
- Connaissance des processus de comptabilité de groupe avec un accent sur la consolidation financière.
- Licence ou Master en Finance ou Finance/IT.
- Compréhension des structures de données SAP (plans comptables, grands livres, postes FS, dimensions).
- Expérience pratique avec les interfaces/ETL, les mappages de données et les réconciliations entre les systèmes sources et les outils de consolidation.
- Expérience dans la planification, le suivi et la livraison de jalons, la gestion des risques et des dépendances.
- Capacité à travailler efficacement avec Group Finance, BU Finance, IT et les partenaires externes.
- Solides compétences en communication, capable de traduire entre les équipes financières et techniques.
- Expérience avec SIT/UAT, définition de cas de test et gestion des défauts.
- Méthode de travail structurée et analytique avec de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes.
- Grande attention aux détails et à la qualité, en particulier concernant les données financières.
- Résilient et à l'aise pour travailler sous pression pendant les cycles de clôture.
- Anglais courant (écrit et parlé) ; des langues supplémentaires sont un plus.
- Expérience de travail dans des programmes complexes et mondiaux, de préférence dans le secteur de l'assurance ou des services financiers.
- Solides compétences en collaboration et attitude « une seule équipe », soutenant les collègues de la Finance et de l'IT.

Vous avez votre place ici.
Imaginez travailler dans l'un des lieux de travail les plus durables au monde. Au Quai Zurich Campus, vous profiterez d'un environnement conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir, avec des avantages qui soutiennent votre bien-être et votre impact, et des opportunités de donner le meilleur de vous-même, entouré de talents de haut niveau et de collègues solidaires.

Vous aurez accès à des options alimentaires saines, des installations de fitness et des espaces lumineux et collaboratifs qui stimulent la créativité. Situé au cœur de Zurich sur les rives du lac de Zurich, le campus offre d'excellentes liaisons de transport public, rendant votre trajet simple.

Grandissez avec nous grâce à l'accès à des ressources d'apprentissage, au développement sur le tas et à une autonomisation et un soutien continus. Faites partie d'une équipe qui crée ensemble un avenir plus brillant.

À propos de nous
Zurich est un assureur multi-lignes de premier plan, au service de plus de 82 millions de clients dans plus de 200 pays et territoires avec plus de 65 000 employés.
Depuis plus de 150 ans, Zurich transforme l'assurance – offrant non seulement une protection, mais aussi des services de prévention qui favorisent le bien-être et la résilience climatique.
Guidés par notre objectif de « créer ensemble un avenir plus brillant », nous visons à être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus impactantes au monde.
Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre candidature en ligne dès aujourd'hui !

Questo ruolo lavorerà su processi, opzioni e business case per utilizzare Databricks per l'integrazione dei dati finanziari, l'analisi e i prodotti dati, e aiuterà i team Finance a capire quando e come utilizzare Databricks rispetto ad altre piattaforme.

Cosa farai

- Definire e documentare i processi Finance che si basano su Databricks (es. preparazione dei dati per il reporting, flussi di lavoro di modellazione, analisi).
- Contribuire al modello operativo Databricks per il Finance: ruoli, responsabilità, modalità di lavoro con i team IT di Gruppo / piattaforme dati.
- Valutare le opzioni di soluzione per le esigenze Finance.

## Description

The Finance Transformation is building a leading connected, collaborative Finance Function which is faster and more insight-driven. We will do this by transforming everything we do, every process, data and tool and injecting new ways of work and AI to amplify our Finance talent.

The Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation plays a key role in the technology stream, ensuring that Group Finance leverages the right platforms for the right processes – across planning, consolidation, reporting and analytics.

This senior role will translate business needs into an integrated solution architecture, guide platform choices and help ensure that tools such as SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan and Databricks are used effectively and consistently across the Group.

## What you will do

- Define and evolve the end to end solution architecture for Group Finance processes (planning, consolidation, reporting, analytics and performance management).
- Ensure each process is supported by the most suitable platform (e.g. SAP Group Reporting for consolidation, Anaplan for planning, Databricks for data and analytics), avoiding duplication and custom “shadow IT”.
- Translate requirements into solution designs, integration patterns and implementation options, balancing standardisation, flexibility and cost.
- Challenge and refine business requirements to fit platform capabilities and long term architecture principles.
- Define how Finance platforms integrate (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, reporting/BI tools) to deliver consistent, governed data for planning and reporting.
- Contribute to the Finance data architecture (data domains, models, flows, lineage) and ensure that key data (actuals, plans, scenarios, KPIs) is managed as a single source of truth.
- Support solution review and design authority processes, ensuring new initiatives adhere to agreed architecture.
- Act as lead Business Solution Architect across key Finance Transformation projects and technology initiatives.
- Provide guidance to project teams on solution options, trade offs and technical risks.
- Review key design artefacts (solution designs, interface specs, data models) and support issue resolution.
- Collaborate closely with Group Finance leadership, BU Finance, Group IT, data/analytics teams and platform owners
- Explain complex architecture topics in clear business language and build consensus around design decisions.
- Contribute to communication and education on the target Finance technology landscape
- Propose improvements to the Finance architecture, including better use of Anaplan and Databricks, standardisation of data and simplification of the system landscape.

## What you bring

- Strong experience in Finance / Group Finance processes, such as planning and forecasting, consolidation, reporting, performance management or capital management.
- Proven track record in solution architecture or senior business/IT design roles within Finance transformation programmes.
- Experience with SAP finance platforms (e.g. S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) and their role in Group reporting.
- Knowledge of Anaplan and Databricks is a strong advantage.
- Solid understanding of data and integration architecture
- Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Ability to lead solution design across multiple projects, balancing strategic direction and pragmatic delivery.
- Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable working with senior Finance and IT stakeholders, platform owners and external partners.
- Structured, analytical and solution oriented mindset.
- Ability to simplify complexity and communicate clearly to non technical audiences.
- Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.
- Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.

## You belong here

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

## About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.
We look forward to receiving your online application today!

## Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

## Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

Descrizione

La Trasformazione Finanziaria sta costruendo una funzione Finance leader, connessa e collaborativa, più rapida e orientata agli insight. Lo faremo trasformando tutto ciò che facciamo, ogni processo, dato e strumento, e introducendo nuove modalità di lavoro e l'IA per potenziare il nostro talento finanziario.

Il Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation svolge un ruolo chiave nel flusso tecnologico, garantendo che il Group Finance sfrutti le piattaforme giuste per i processi corretti, tra pianificazione, consolidamento, reporting e analisi.

Questo ruolo senior tradurrà le esigenze aziendali in un'architettura di soluzione integrata, guiderà le scelte di piattaforma e contribuirà a garantire che strumenti come SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan e Databricks siano utilizzati in modo efficace e coerente in tutto il Gruppo.

Cosa farai

- Definire ed evolvere l'architettura di soluzione end-to-end per i processi del Group Finance (pianificazione, consolidamento, reporting, analisi e gestione delle performance).
- Garantire che ogni processo sia supportato dalla piattaforma più adatta (es. SAP Group Reporting per il consolidamento, Anaplan per la pianificazione, Databricks per dati e analisi), evitando duplicazioni e "shadow IT" personalizzati.
- Tradurre i requisiti in design di soluzioni, modelli di integrazione e opzioni di implementazione, bilanciando standardizzazione, flessibilità e costi.
- Sfidare e perfezionare i requisiti aziendali per adattarli alle capacità della piattaforma e ai principi architettonici a lungo termine.
- Definire come le piattaforme Finance si integrano (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, strumenti di reporting/BI) per fornire dati coerenti e governati per la pianificazione e il reporting.
- Contribuire all'architettura dei dati Finance (domini di dati, modelli, flussi, lineage) e garantire che i dati chiave (effettivi, piani, scenari, KPI) siano gestiti come un'unica fonte di verità.
- Supportare i processi di revisione delle soluzioni e di design authority, garantendo che le nuove iniziative aderiscano all'architettura concordata.
- Agire come Business Solution Architect principale in progetti chiave di Trasformazione Finanziaria e iniziative tecnologiche.
- Fornire guida ai team di progetto su opzioni di soluzione, compromessi e rischi tecnici.
- Revisionare gli artefatti di design chiave (design di soluzione, specifiche di interfaccia, modelli di dati) e supportare la risoluzione dei problemi.
- Collaborare strettamente con la leadership del Group Finance, il Finance delle BU, il Group IT, i team di dati/analisi e i proprietari delle piattaforme.
- Spiegare argomenti architettonici complessi in un linguaggio aziendale chiaro e costruire il consenso attorno alle decisioni di design.
- Contribuire alla comunicazione e alla formazione sul panorama tecnologico Finance target.
- Proporre miglioramenti all'architettura Finance, incluso un migliore utilizzo di Anaplan e Databricks, la standardizzazione dei dati e la semplificazione del panorama dei sistemi.

Cosa porti

- Solida esperienza nei processi Finance / Group Finance, come pianificazione e previsione, consolidamento, reporting, gestione delle performance o gestione del capitale.
- Comprovata esperienza nell'architettura di soluzioni o in ruoli di design aziendale/IT senior all'interno di programmi di trasformazione finanziaria.
- Esperienza con piattaforme finanziarie SAP (es. S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) e il loro ruolo nel reporting di Gruppo.
- La conoscenza di Anaplan e Databricks costituisce un forte vantaggio.
- Solida comprensione dell'architettura dei dati e dell'integrazione.
- Esperienza di lavoro in programmi complessi e globali, preferibilmente nel settore assicurativo o dei servizi finanziari.
- Capacità di guidare il design delle soluzioni su più progetti, bilanciando direzione strategica e delivery pragmatica.
- Forti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder; a proprio agio nel lavorare con stakeholder senior Finance e IT, proprietari di piattaforme e partner esterni.
- Mentalità strutturata, analitica e orientata alla soluzione.
- Capacità di semplificare la complessità e comunicare chiaramente a un pubblico non tecnico.
- Forti capacità di collaborazione e attitudine al "lavoro di squadra", supportando sia i colleghi Finance che IT.
- Inglese fluente (scritto e parlato); lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

Il tuo posto è qui

Immagina di lavorare in uno degli ambienti di lavoro più sostenibili al mondo. Al Quai Zurich Campus, godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a crescere, con benefit che supportano il tuo benessere e il tuo impatto, e opportunità per dare il meglio di te, circondato da talenti di alto livello e colleghi solidali.
Avrai accesso a opzioni alimentari sane, strutture per il fitness e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che stimolano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre eccellenti collegamenti con i trasporti pubblici, rendendo il tuo tragitto semplice.
Cresci con noi attraverso l'accesso a risorse di apprendimento, sviluppo sul lavoro e supporto continuo. Fai parte di un team che sta creando insieme un futuro più luminoso.

Chi siamo

Zurich è un assicuratore multi-linea leader, che serve oltre 82 milioni di clienti in più di 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.
Da oltre 150 anni, Zurich trasforma il settore assicurativo, offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.
Guidati dal nostro scopo di "creare insieme un futuro più luminoso", miriamo a essere una delle aziende più responsabili e di impatto al mondo.
Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online oggi stesso!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

The Finance Transformation is building a leading connected, collaborative Finance Function which is faster and more insight-driven. We will do this by transforming everything we do, every process, data and tool and injecting new ways of work and AI to amplify our Finance talent.

The Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation plays a key role in the technology stream, ensuring that Group Finance leverages the right platforms for the right processes – across planning, consolidation, reporting and analytics.

This senior role will translate business needs into an integrated solution architecture, guide platform choices and help ensure that tools such as SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan and Databricks are used effectively and consistently across the Group.

What you will do

- Define and evolve the end to end solution architecture for Group Finance processes (planning, consolidation, reporting, analytics and performance management).
- Ensure each process is supported by the most suitable platform (e.g. SAP Group Reporting for consolidation, Anaplan for planning, Databricks for data and analytics), avoiding duplication and custom “shadow IT”.
- Translate requirements into solution designs, integration patterns and implementation options, balancing standardisation, flexibility and cost.
- Challenge and refine business requirements to fit platform capabilities and long term architecture principles.
- Define how Finance platforms integrate (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, reporting/BI tools) to deliver consistent, governed data for planning and reporting.
- Contribute to the Finance data architecture (data domains, models, flows, lineage) and ensure that key data (actuals, plans, scenarios, KPIs) is managed as a single source of truth.
- Support solution review and design authority processes, ensuring new initiatives adhere to agreed architecture.
- Act as lead Business Solution Architect across key Finance Transformation projects and technology initiatives.
- Provide guidance to project teams on solution options, trade offs and technical risks.
- Review key design artefacts (solution designs, interface specs, data models) and support issue resolution.
- Collaborate closely with Group Finance leadership, BU Finance, Group IT, data/analytics teams and platform owners
- Explain complex architecture topics in clear business language and build consensus around design decisions.
- Contribute to communication and education on the target Finance technology landscape
- Propose improvements to the Finance architecture, including better use of Anaplan and Databricks, standardisation of data and simplification of the system landscape.

What you bring

- Strong experience in Finance / Group Finance processes, such as planning and forecasting, consolidation, reporting, performance management or capital management.
- Proven track record in solution architecture or senior business/IT design roles within Finance transformation programmes.
- Experience with SAP finance platforms (e.g. S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) and their role in Group reporting.
- Knowledge of Anaplan and Databricks is a strong advantage.
- Solid understanding of data and integration architecture
- Experience working in complex, global programmes, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Ability to lead solution design across multiple projects, balancing strategic direction and pragmatic delivery.
- Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable working with senior Finance and IT stakeholders, platform owners and external partners.
- Structured, analytical and solution oriented mindset.
- Ability to simplify complexity and communicate clearly to non technical audiences.
- Strong collaboration skills and a “one team” attitude, supporting both Finance and IT colleagues.
- Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.

You belong here

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.
You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.
We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Beschreibung

Die Finance Transformation baut eine führende, vernetzte und kollaborative Finanzfunktion auf, die schneller und erkenntnisorientierter arbeitet. Wir erreichen dies, indem wir alles, was wir tun – jeden Prozess, jede Datenquelle und jedes Tool – transformieren und neue Arbeitsweisen sowie KI einsetzen, um unsere Finanztalente zu stärken.

Der Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation spielt eine Schlüsselrolle im Technologie-Stream und stellt sicher, dass Group Finance die richtigen Plattformen für die richtigen Prozesse nutzt – über Planung, Konsolidierung, Reporting und Analytik hinweg.

Diese Senior-Rolle übersetzt geschäftliche Anforderungen in eine integrierte Lösungsarchitektur, steuert Plattformentscheidungen und stellt sicher, dass Tools wie SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan und Databricks effektiv und konsistent in der gesamten Gruppe eingesetzt werden.

Was Sie tun werden

- Definition und Weiterentwicklung der End-to-End-Lösungsarchitektur für Group Finance-Prozesse (Planung, Konsolidierung, Reporting, Analytik und Performance Management).
- Sicherstellung, dass jeder Prozess durch die am besten geeignete Plattform unterstützt wird (z. B. SAP Group Reporting für Konsolidierung, Anaplan für Planung, Databricks für Daten und Analytik), um Duplikate und benutzerdefinierte „Shadow IT“ zu vermeiden.
- Übersetzung von Anforderungen in Lösungsdesigns, Integrationsmuster und Implementierungsoptionen unter Abwägung von Standardisierung, Flexibilität und Kosten.
- Hinterfragen und Verfeinern von Geschäftsanforderungen, um sie an Plattformfähigkeiten und langfristige Architekturprinzipien anzupassen.
- Definition der Integration von Finanzplattformen (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, Reporting/BI-Tools), um konsistente, gesteuerte Daten für Planung und Reporting bereitzustellen.
- Beitrag zur Finanzdatenarchitektur (Datenbereiche, Modelle, Flüsse, Lineage) und Sicherstellung, dass Schlüsseldaten (Ist-Werte, Pläne, Szenarien, KPIs) als Single Source of Truth verwaltet werden.
- Unterstützung von Lösungsprüfungs- und Design-Authority-Prozessen, um sicherzustellen, dass neue Initiativen der vereinbarten Architektur entsprechen.
- Tätigkeit als leitender Business Solution Architect bei wichtigen Finance Transformation-Projekten und Technologieinitiativen.
- Beratung von Projektteams zu Lösungsoptionen, Kompromissen und technischen Risiken.
- Überprüfung wichtiger Design-Artefakte (Lösungsdesigns, Schnittstellenspezifikationen, Datenmodelle) und Unterstützung bei der Problemlösung.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Group Finance-Führung, BU Finance, Group IT, Daten-/Analytik-Teams und Plattform-Eigentümern.
- Erklärung komplexer Architekturthemen in klarer Geschäftssprache und Konsensbildung bei Designentscheidungen.
- Beitrag zur Kommunikation und Schulung zur angestrebten Finanztechnologielandschaft.
- Vorschlagen von Verbesserungen der Finanzarchitektur, einschließlich besserer Nutzung von Anaplan und Databricks, Standardisierung von Daten und Vereinfachung der Systemlandschaft.

Was Sie mitbringen

- Fundierte Erfahrung in Finance / Group Finance-Prozessen, wie Planung und Forecasting, Konsolidierung, Reporting, Performance Management oder Kapitalmanagement.
- Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Lösungsarchitektur oder in leitenden Business-/IT-Design-Rollen innerhalb von Finanztransformationsprogrammen.
- Erfahrung mit SAP-Finanzplattformen (z. B. S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) und deren Rolle im Group Reporting.
- Kenntnisse in Anaplan und Databricks sind ein starker Vorteil.
- Fundiertes Verständnis von Daten- und Integrationsarchitektur.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit in komplexen, globalen Programmen, vorzugsweise im Versicherungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungssektor.
- Fähigkeit, das Lösungsdesign über mehrere Projekte hinweg zu leiten und dabei strategische Ausrichtung und pragmatische Umsetzung in Einklang zu bringen.
- Starke Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten; sicher im Umgang mit Senior Finance- und IT-Stakeholdern, Plattform-Eigentümern und externen Partnern.
- Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Denkweise.
- Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu vereinfachen und klar gegenüber nicht-technischem Publikum zu kommunizieren.
- Starke Kooperationsfähigkeiten und eine „One Team“-Einstellung, die sowohl Finanz- als auch IT-Kollegen unterstützt.
- Fließend in Englisch (Wort und Schrift); weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

Sie gehören hierher

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zurich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die darauf ausgelegt ist, dass Sie erfolgreich sind, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, Ihr Bestes zu geben, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.
Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Essensoptionen, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität anregen. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus hervorragende Anbindungen an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr, was Ihren Arbeitsweg einfach macht.
Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung sowie kontinuierliche Befähigung und Unterstützung. Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine hellere Zukunft gestaltet.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multi-Line-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Gebieten mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern bedient.
Seit über 150 Jahren transformiert Zurich das Versicherungswesen – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsdienste, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresilienz fördern.
Geleitet von unserem Ziel, „gemeinsam eine hellere Zukunft zu gestalten“, streben wir danach, eines der verantwortungsbewusstesten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt zu sein.
Wir freuen uns darauf, Ihre Online-Bewerbung noch heute zu erhalten!

Description

La Transformation Financière construit une fonction Finance de premier plan, connectée et collaborative, plus rapide et axée sur les données. Nous y parviendrons en transformant tout ce que nous faisons, chaque processus, donnée et outil, et en injectant de nouvelles méthodes de travail et l'IA pour amplifier nos talents financiers.

Le Business Solution Architect – Finance Transformation joue un rôle clé dans le flux technologique, en veillant à ce que le Group Finance exploite les bonnes plateformes pour les bons processus – en matière de planification, consolidation, reporting et analyse.

Ce rôle senior traduira les besoins de l'entreprise en une architecture de solution intégrée, guidera les choix de plateformes et aidera à garantir que des outils tels que SAP Group Reporting, Anaplan et Databricks soient utilisés de manière efficace et cohérente dans tout le Groupe.

Ce que vous ferez

- Définir et faire évoluer l'architecture de solution de bout en bout pour les processus du Group Finance (planification, consolidation, reporting, analyse et gestion de la performance).
- Veiller à ce que chaque processus soit soutenu par la plateforme la plus adaptée (ex: SAP Group Reporting pour la consolidation, Anaplan pour la planification, Databricks pour les données et l'analyse), en évitant les doublons et le « shadow IT » personnalisé.
- Traduire les exigences en conceptions de solutions, modèles d'intégration et options de mise en œuvre, en équilibrant standardisation, flexibilité et coûts.
- Remettre en question et affiner les exigences métier pour les adapter aux capacités des plateformes et aux principes d'architecture à long terme.
- Définir comment les plateformes Finance s'intègrent (SAP, Anaplan, Databricks, outils de reporting/BI) pour fournir des données cohérentes et gouvernées pour la planification et le reporting.
- Contribuer à l'architecture des données Finance (domaines de données, modèles, flux, lignage) et veiller à ce que les données clés (réels, plans, scénarios, KPI) soient gérées comme une source unique de vérité.
- Soutenir les processus d'examen des solutions et d'autorité de conception, en veillant à ce que les nouvelles initiatives respectent l'architecture convenue.
- Agir en tant que Business Solution Architect principal sur les projets clés de Transformation Financière et les initiatives technologiques.
- Fournir des conseils aux équipes de projet sur les options de solution, les compromis et les risques techniques.
- Examiner les artefacts de conception clés (conceptions de solutions, spécifications d'interface, modèles de données) et soutenir la résolution des problèmes.
- Collaborer étroitement avec la direction du Group Finance, le Finance des BU, le Group IT, les équipes de données/analyse et les propriétaires de plateformes.
- Expliquer des sujets d'architecture complexes dans un langage métier clair et construire un consensus autour des décisions de conception.
- Contribuer à la communication et à l'éducation sur le paysage technologique Finance cible.
- Proposer des améliorations à l'architecture Finance, y compris une meilleure utilisation d'Anaplan et Databricks, la standardisation des données et la simplification du paysage système.

Ce que vous apportez

- Solide expérience dans les processus Finance / Group Finance, tels que la planification et les prévisions, la consolidation, le reporting, la gestion de la performance ou la gestion du capital.
- Expérience avérée en architecture de solutions ou dans des rôles de conception métier/IT senior au sein de programmes de transformation financière.
- Expérience avec les plateformes financières SAP (ex: S/4HANA Finance, SAP Group Reporting) et leur rôle dans le reporting de Groupe.
- La connaissance d'Anaplan et Databricks est un atout majeur.
- Solide compréhension de l'architecture des données et de l'intégration.
- Expérience de travail dans des programmes complexes et mondiaux, de préférence dans le secteur de l'assurance ou des services financiers.
- Capacité à diriger la conception de solutions sur plusieurs projets, en équilibrant direction stratégique et livraison pragmatique.
- Solides compétences en gestion des parties prenantes ; à l'aise pour travailler avec des parties prenantes senior Finance et IT, des propriétaires de plateformes et des partenaires externes.
- Esprit structuré, analytique et orienté solution.
- Capacité à simplifier la complexité et à communiquer clairement à des publics non techniques.
- Solides compétences en collaboration et attitude « une seule équipe », soutenant à la fois les collègues Finance et IT.
- Anglais courant (écrit et parlé) ; des langues supplémentaires sont un atout.

Vous avez votre place ici

Imaginez travailler dans l'un des environnements de travail les plus durables au monde. Au Quai Zurich Campus, vous profiterez d'un environnement conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir, avec des avantages qui soutiennent votre bien-être et votre impact, et des opportunités de donner le meilleur de vous-même, entouré de talents de haut niveau et de collègues solidaires.
Vous aurez accès à des options alimentaires saines, des installations de fitness et des espaces lumineux et collaboratifs qui stimulent la créativité. Situé au cœur de Zurich, sur les rives du lac de Zurich, le campus offre d'excellentes liaisons de transport public, rendant votre trajet simple.
Grandissez avec nous grâce à l'accès à des ressources d'apprentissage, au développement sur le tas et à un soutien continu. Faites partie d'une équipe qui crée ensemble un avenir plus brillant.

À propos de nous

Zurich est un assureur multi-lignes de premier plan, au service de plus de 82 millions de clients dans plus de 200 pays et territoires avec plus de 65 000 employés.
Depuis plus de 150 ans, Zurich transforme l'assurance – offrant non seulement une protection, mais aussi des services de prévention qui favorisent le bien-être et la résilience climatique.
Guidés par notre objectif de « créer ensemble un avenir plus brillant », nous visons à être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus impactantes au monde.
Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre candidature en ligne dès aujourd'hui !

## Description

Zurich Insurance is on an exciting journey to become a truly customer led organization.

Zurich’s Group Customer Office is playing a pivotal role on that journey and is involved in a broad range of activities - working with all our regions and markets across the globe to shape the customer agenda.

To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, data-driven, and innovative insights expert to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in evaluating our brand health and customer experience through our continuous Global Brand tracking study and Relationship NPS studies that inform decision making across 20+ markets and at every level of the business. These fundamental studies enable us to diagnose brand perceptions and deep dive into the customer experience (CX) shaping future strategies and improving how we deliver against customer needs. Working closely with local markets, as well as regional management and other Group functions, this role will include planning, delivery and evolving these tools to ensure data-based insights are generated to influence business decisions and actions. As the volume and volume and complexity of data grows, we’re evolving how we work - embracing AI tools to accelerate data processing and transform how insight is presented to the business. Our intention is to spend less time on production and more time on interpretation, implementation and communication that drives action.

Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, the candidate’s key responsibilities will focus on consistently delivering these important insights platforms, so they evolve with the business needs and drive change.

## What you will do

- Act as customer champion, raising awareness, providing guidance and training to the organization on key dimensions and insights of our program to drive actions.
- Take ownership of the two continuous global studies and ad hoc retail RNPS studies ensuring smooth project management and delivery of robust and relevant data and KPIs into the business.
- Apply AI and emerging technology to insight work to increase efficiency in data processing, synthesis and reporting, enabling shaper focus on interpretation, narrative and business implication.
- Define, evolve and conduct global studies, coordinating between multitude of markets and partnering with the respective agency.
- Analyze feedback, derive insight, report and present to stakeholders across the organization, including senior management at global, regional and local level.
- Drive the combination of data sources to strengthen relevance to decision making and impact on performance e.g. correlation analysis linking customer experience with financials.
- Ensure programs are technically strong and appropriate from questionnaire development, sample, weighting rules, and data uploads building confidence in the tool’s robustness.
- Translate analytic insights into concrete actionable recommendations, drawing conclusions for business improvement and influencing strategy effectively, including workshop facilitation.
- Maintain and promote our data hosting platform to democratize insights across the business.
- Manage external research agencies and budgets.
- Input support to Senior Insight Manager in identifying, communicating and activating insights.
- Keep up with best practice in the field and transfer relevant topics into Zurich’s programs.

Work location is Zurich with travel potentially required up to 10%

## What you bring

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree (e.g., in business studies/administration, research, data science, psychology, behaviour science, customer or change management), 5+ years of experience in managing insights to actions programs.
- Expertise in managing customer research as part of an in-house customer insight team or as part of a consulting practice, ideally coupled with solid expertise in NPS and/or brand tracking methodology.
- A curiosity and experience exploring or applying AI tools in a research/insight context (e.g. verbatim analysis, automated reporting, cross market synthesis).
- Passionate and curious about data analysis & identifying insights to facilitate action planning.
- Program management and coordination skills to build and drive studies across 19+ markets including managing study preparation and execution (e.g. study set up and design, sampling strategy definition, execution, reporting), driving alignment between markets and ensuring global study framework is applied and adhered to.
- Ability to work with larger sets of data (Excel, SPSS) to provide additional/ad-hoc analysis (creating cuts of data based on different stakeholder requirements in addition to agency results packs).
- Experience in working with markets across the globe as well as ability to build and manage relationships across different cultural clusters.
- Strong analytical, (insights) writing/communications as well as workshop facilitation skills.
- Ability to guide virtual teams, e.g., establish and run global VOC community.
- Solid knowledge of insurance market, operations, products and services.
- Working language is primarily English.
